info.name: Holy Competition API
info.description:
REST API for the Holy Competition app. Built with Next.js Route Handlers and Supabase Auth.

**Authentication**
All endpoints (except `/health`) require a valid Supabase JWT.
Set the `accessToken` collection variable to your Supabase `access_token` and every request will include it automatically as a Bearer token.

**Idempotency**
Every reward-bearing POST requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Keep the same key when retrying a request; use a new key for a new action.

**Base URL**
Switch the `baseUrl` variable between `http://localhost:3000` (local) and your production URL.

variable.description: Base URL of the API. Change to your production URL when needed.
Supabase access_token (JWT). Paste the value returned by supabase.auth.getSession().
UUID of a notification to mark as read.
UUID of a challenge assignment to claim.
Code of the demon to inspect or encounter.
UUID of a demon encounter. Set this from a start or list-encounters response.
UUID of a defense assignment within an encounter.
UUID of a church. The default is the seeded St. Mary Cathedral record.
UUID of a church change request. The default is the seeded pending request.
UUID of a prayer intention for administrator review. The default is the seeded pending intention.
UUID of a visible prayer intention. The default is the seeded approved intention.
UUID of a confirmed friend. The default is the seeded Maria Santos friendship.
UUID of a friend request. The default is John Paul's seeded pending request to Test User.
Set this to one of the authenticated user's pending outgoing friend requests before using the cancel request.

item.name: Health
item.description: Service liveness check — no authentication required.

request.description: Returns 200 when the API is reachable. No auth token required. Use this as a liveness probe.

item.name: Contact us
item.description: Public support form. No authentication is required. Choose `Other` only when also supplying `otherSubject`.

request.description: Stores the support request and returns only its ID and creation time. Valid subjects: Billing & Payments; Subscription Management; Login & Account Access; App Performance & Bugs; Audio & Playback Issues; Streak & Progress Issues; Content Feedback & Requests; Prayer Intentions; Grammar & Audio Mistakes; Parish & Church Programs; School & Ministry Licensing; Media & Press Inquiries; or Other. For Other, include `otherSubject` (2–120 characters).

item.name: Prayer Intentions
item.description: Submit prayer intentions for administrator approval, browse approved intentions, and review the authenticated user's submissions. All requests require a Supabase JWT.

request.description: Lists only administrator-approved, unexpired prayer-intention cards with the creator's display name, avatar, country code, and aggregate prayerCount.
Creates a pending intention. Title is limited to 120 characters and description to 250 characters. It is not public until an administrator makes it visible.
Returns one approved, unexpired card with aggregate prayerCount. Pending, rejected, expired, and unknown IDs all return 404.
Records one append-only prayer for the authenticated user. Repeat prayers are allowed; there is no undo. Only visible, unexpired intentions can receive prayers.

item.name: List people who prayed (creator or admin)

request.description: Lists one record per prayer, including who prayed and when. Only the intention creator or an administrator can use this request.
Lists the authenticated user's pending, visible, and rejected intentions until each reviewed intention expires, including each intention's aggregate prayerCount.

item.name: Admin · Prayer Intentions
item.description: Administrator-only moderation queue. Use the seeded test@test.com account's JWT locally. Only pending intentions can be reviewed.

request.description: Lists submitted prayer intentions for an administrator. Set status=all to inspect reviewed records too.
Approves a pending intention, makes it visible for one month, and awards its creator a badge if this reaches an approved-intention threshold of 1, 3, or 7.
Rejects a pending intention. It remains in the creator's history until its one-month review-based expiry, but is never public and earns no badge.

item.name: Examination of conscience
item.description: Public daily examination question. No authentication is required; the same date and filters deterministically select the same curated question.

query.description: Optional ISO date for deterministic historical/preview requests.

request.description: Returns one active question. Omit date to select from today's questions using EXAMINATION_TIMEZONE (America/Chicago by default).

item.name: Admin — Examination of conscience
item.description: Administrator-only question management. Database RLS independently enforces the admin role.

body.raw:
{
  "category": "single",
  "title": "Faith",
  "commandment": 1,
  "type": "grave",
  "question": "Have I placed created things above God?",
  "description": "Idolatry displaces God.",
  "counsels": ["Return to prayer."],
  "prevention": ["Keep a daily prayer time."],
  "saints": ["St. Augustine"]
}

item.name: Liturgy
item.description: Catholic Mass readings backed by a local lectionary dataset. For country=US, a versioned local USCCB snapshot takes precedence; its source URL and lectionary number are returned in metadata. The API maps available citations to NABRE verse text from checked-in book files and makes no external liturgical request at runtime.

request.description: Uses LITURGY_TIMEZONE (America/Chicago by default) to determine today’s date. Each reading includes mapped local NABRE verse text. A 404 READINGS_NOT_FOUND means the calendar resolved but the local lectionary dataset has no entry; the API never guesses citations.

The date path must be a real YYYY-MM-DD value. Every reading includes mapped local NABRE verse text. Christmas returns its Vigil, Night, Dawn, and Day variants in readingSets, while readings exposes the first valid set for convenience.

item.name: Locations
item.description: Authenticated country and city autocomplete. Location records are derived from the Countries States Cities Database under ODbL v1.0: https://github.com/dr5hn/countries-states-cities-database

query.description: Optional case-insensitive country name or ISO2 search (1–120 characters). Disable this parameter to list all countries alphabetically.

request.description: Returns active countries with code, name, latitude, and longitude. Exact ISO code or name matches rank first, followed by name-prefix and substring matches. The response includes limit, offset, hasMore, and nextOffset metadata.

Returns active cities inside the selected country. Exact names rank first, followed by prefix and substring matches. Each result includes the app city UUID, region/state, country code, IANA timezone, latitude, and longitude.

item.name: Churches
item.description: Search the approved church directory and retrieve a church's recurring services with its live status.

query.description: Optional two-letter country code. If multiple filters are supplied, each must match the same church.
Optional church-city name. This is not an app.cities ID. If multiple filters are supplied, each must match the same church.
Optional canonical diocese name. If multiple filters are supplied, each must match the same church.

request.description: Returns approved churches. Supply at least one country, city, or diocese filter; when multiple filters are supplied, they must all match the same church. Results include latitude and longitude; retrieve one church for its full address, weekly schedule, and live availability.

item.name: Get church details and live status

request.description: Returns the complete church address, latitude/longitude, diocese, recurring weekday Mass/confession/adoration times, and live status. `massInProgress`, `confessionInProgress`, and `adorationInProgress` are computed at request time in the church's timezone and may all be true together. A missing end time means one hour.

item.name: My Churches
item.description: Link churches to the current user and optionally set one as primary.

request.description: Lists the authenticated user's church links, primary flag, and church summaries.
Links an active church to the authenticated user. Set `isPrimary` to true to atomically make it the user's only primary church.
Makes an already-linked church the user's primary church.
Removes a church link for the authenticated user. Returns 204.

item.name: Church Change Requests
item.description: Submit a proposed church or full replacement weekly schedule for moderator approval.

request.description: Lists change requests submitted by the authenticated user.

Creates a pending change request. On approval, the supplied service-time array replaces the church's entire recurring weekly schedule. Omit `endTime` to use the one-hour default. Use `requestType: createChurch` with a `church` object, including required numeric `latitude` and `longitude`, to propose a new church.

body.raw:
{
  "requestType": "createChurch",
  "church": {
    "dioceseId": "c5000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "name": "Example Catholic Church",
    "addressLine1": "123 Example Street",
    "addressLine2": null,
    "city": "Austin",
    "regionName": "Texas",
    "postalCode": "78701",
    "countryCode": "US",
    "timezone": "America/Chicago",
    "latitude": 30.2672,
    "longitude": -97.7431
  },
  "serviceTimes": [
    {
      "serviceType": "mass",
      "weekday": "sunday",
      "startTime": "09:00",
      "endTime": null
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Please add this church to the directory."
}

request.description: Creates a pending church-directory request. Latitude (-90 to 90) and longitude (-180 to 180) are required and stored when an administrator approves the request.

item.name: Admin · Church Change Requests
item.description: Administrator-only review queue. test@test.com is the seeded admin account.

request.description: Lists submitted church change requests. Requires the authenticated user to hold the app admin role.

Approves a pending request. A new-church request creates the church and its schedule; a schedule-update request atomically replaces the existing church schedule and awards the submitting user a repeatable Church Schedule Steward badge.

item.name: Friends
item.description: Username discovery, username-only friend requests, confirmed-friend stats, earned badges, period-points rankings, and all-in-one comparisons. Usernames are matched case-insensitively.

query.description: Required username substring (4–30 letters, numbers, or underscores).

request.description: Finds active users by a case-insensitive username substring. The current user is excluded; each result includes avatar, title, and relationship state for deciding whether to send a friend request.
Lists requests involving the authenticated user. Defaults are incoming pending requests.
Creates a pending request and recipient notification. A reciprocal pending request is accepted automatically; matching is case-insensitive.
Only the recipient may accept or reject a pending request. Acceptance notifies the original sender.
Only the recipient may reject an incoming pending request.
Only the sender can cancel a pending request.
Lists confirmed friends with their current level, total XP, qualifying Rosary total, badge-instance count, and timezone-aware Rosary streaks when include=rosaryStreak is supplied.

query.description: Optional. Adds the friend's timezone-aware Rosary streak.

request.description: Returns shared profile, total XP, current level, Rosary total, and every earned badge instance. Add include=rosaryStreak to receive the friend's timezone-aware streak. Internal badge metadata is not exposed.

Ranks the authenticated user and confirmed friends by the same period points as the existing leaderboard. The response also includes `currentUserEntry` even when the authenticated user is outside the requested page (or `null` when no entry is available).

Returns the authenticated user and confirmed friends in one comparison view. Entries include period rank and activity counts, total XP, lifetime points, current level, Rosary total, badge count, and timezone-aware Rosary streaks.
Removes the confirmed friendship for both users.

item.name: Profile (me)
item.description: Validate usernames, then read and update the authenticated user's profile.

query.description: Required candidate. The API checks format, prohibited terms, and case-insensitive availability.

request.description: Returns `valid`, `available`, and a machine-readable reason (`INVALID_LENGTH`, `INVALID_CHARACTERS`, `PROHIBITED_TERM`, or `USERNAME_TAKEN`). The response always includes five available, time-seeded Christian and saint-themed username suggestions.
Returns the full profile for the authenticated user, including required `gender`, optional `saintAvatarId`, and resolved `cityName` and `state` (both `null` when no city is set).

Partially updates the user's profile. Send only the fields you want to change — at least one field is required.

**Fields**
- `displayName` (string, 2–80 chars)
- `username` (string, 3–30 chars, letters/numbers/underscores, nullable; screened against English and Spanish prohibited-term data)
- `avatarUrl` (URL string, nullable)
- `title` (string, max 100 chars, nullable)
- `gender` (`"male"` | `"female"`)
- `saintAvatarId` (saint UUID, nullable)
- `preferredLanguage` (string, 2–10 chars, e.g. `"en"`)
- `timezone` (IANA timezone string, e.g. `"America/Los_Angeles"`)
- `cityId` (UUID, nullable; the response resolves it to `cityName` and `state`)
- `countryCode` (2-letter ISO code, e.g. `"US"`, nullable)
- `leaderboardVisibility` (`"public"` | `"friends"` | `"private"`)
- `prayerMapVisibility` (`"aggregated"` | `"hidden"`)

Returns **409** if the username is already taken and **422** when it fails moderation.

item.name: Progress & Levels
item.description: XP progress, level breakdown, and the full level definition catalog.

request.description: Returns the user's total XP, lifetime/weekly/yearly points, current and next level definitions, percentage progress through the current level, and XP thresholds.
Returns all active level definitions ordered by `level_number` ascending. Each entry contains the level name, minimum XP required, and any associated perks.

query.description: Optional UI focus year. Defaults to the authenticated user's current local year.
Optional UI focus month (1–12). Defaults to the authenticated user's current local month and does not change year-to-date math.

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's timezone-aware rosary completion for all twelve months of the selected year and every calendar day in the selected month. Each `days` entry contains `day`, ISO `date`, and `completed`. A local calendar day is complete when at least one self-reported or verified rosary has a `completed_at` timestamp that day; rejected rosaries are excluded.

The selected month always includes every calendar day, including dates before account creation and future dates. `completed` is `null` for a future date. Eligible-day and completed-day aggregates continue to begin on the later of January 1 and the local account-creation date, and future aggregate days are excluded. The response includes `selectedMonth` for UI focus, plus year-to-date totals that are unaffected by this parameter.

Returns the authenticated user's active Rosary streak and the longest streak in their current local calendar year. A local day counts when at least one self-reported or verified Rosary is completed. The active streak can end yesterday while the current local day remains incomplete; it resets after a full missed local day.
Returns `rosariesPrayed`, the authenticated user's lifetime sum of self-reported and verified Rosary activity quantities. Rejected activities are excluded.

item.name: Virtues
item.description: The authenticated user's current virtue values alongside the active virtue catalog.

request.description: Returns every active virtue definition together with the current user's value, initialization state, and last update time. Values are read-only through this endpoint.

item.name: Demons
item.description: Read-only demon catalog and individual battle definitions.

request.description: Returns active demons with their saint mentor and primary/secondary virtue affinities. This is catalog data; it does not reveal another user's battle state.
Returns one demon's attacks, defenses, virtue affinities, saint mentor, and defeat reward. Set `demonCode`, for example `SCROLLZILLA`.

item.name: Demon Encounters
item.description: Start, inspect, complete, and abandon the authenticated user's demon encounters. The server calculates all virtue, damage, XP, badge, and notification outcomes.

query.description: active | defeated | abandoned | expired | all. Default: all.
Number of encounters per page. Min 1, max 100.

request.description: Lists the current user's encounters with demon summaries. Copy an encounter ID into `encounterId` to inspect it or perform an action.

header.description: Required. Reuse this value only to retry the same start request.

request.description: Creates an active encounter and its first assigned defense. Save `data.encounter.id` as `encounterId` and `data.assignment.id` as `defenseAssignmentId`. A second active encounter with the same demon returns 409.

query.description: Battle timeline events per page. Min 1, max 100.

request.description: Returns one owned encounter, its demon, assigned defenses, and a cursor-paginated battle timeline.

header.description: Required. Retrying with this key returns the original authoritative battle result.

request.description: Completes an owned, assigned defense. The RPC validates state, updates the virtue and HP, records immutable events, applies a defeat reward if appropriate, and creates notifications. No client-provided reward values are accepted.

header.description: Required. Reuse this value only to retry the same abandon request.

request.description: Ends an active owned encounter and cancels its uncompleted defense assignments. This action has no XP or virtue reward.

item.name: Activities
item.description: Record and browse spiritual activities (prayer, Bible reading, fasting, etc.).

query.description: Number of results per page. Min 1, max 100. Default 20.
ISO 8601 timestamp cursor. Pass `nextCursor` from a previous response to paginate.
Filter by activity type (e.g. PRAYER, BIBLE_READING). Case-insensitive.

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's spiritual activities in reverse chronological order.

Pagination uses a cursor-based approach:
1. Check `meta.hasMore` in the response.
2. If `true`, pass `meta.nextCursor` as the `before` query parameter in the next request.

header.description: A unique string (max 150 chars) per submission. Reusing the same key replays the original result without double-counting. Required.

request.description:
Records a spiritual activity through a transactional RPC. The server, not the client, calculates XP, challenge updates, equipment-requirement progress, and any mapped defense completion.

**Required fields**
- `activityCode` (string, 1–50 chars) — e.g. `PRAYER`, `SCRIPTURE`, `SERVICE`, `TRUST_ACT`
- `occurredAt` (ISO 8601 with offset) — when the activity happened
- `quantity` (integer, 1–100) — default `1`

**Optional fields**
- `completedAt` (ISO 8601 with offset, nullable)
- `durationSeconds` (integer, 0–86400, nullable)
- `cityId` (UUID, nullable)
- `countryCode` (2-letter ISO, nullable)
- `metadata` (object) — factual context used by server-defined rules; for example `{"planCompleted": true}` for a completed Scripture plan or `{"duringDifficulty": true}` for an act of trust

Do not send `virtueIncrease`, `demonDamage`, `xpAward`, `badgeEarned`, or `defenseCompleted`; those values are rejected by the request schema and calculated server-side.

The response contains `progressUpdates`, `battleUpdates`, `newBadges`, and `xp` in addition to the activity.

**Idempotency-Key header** (required) — generate a UUID per submission. If you retry with the same key, the server returns `200` with the original result instead of repeating rewards.

item.name: Challenges
item.description: Browse assigned challenges and claim rewards for completed ones.

query.description: Filter by assignment status. One of: active | completed | expired | cancelled | all. Default: active.

request.description: Returns the current user's challenge assignments joined with their challenge definitions. Each item includes a computed `progressPercentage` (0–100).

header.description: Required. Retry the same claim with this key to return the original reward result.

request.description:
Claims the server-calculated reward for a completed challenge assignment. The assignment must be in `completed` status and may only be claimed once.

Set the `assignmentId` collection variable (or path parameter) to the UUID of the assignment. The required `Idempotency-Key` prevents retrying clients from receiving duplicate XP or badges.

Returns **404** if the assignment does not exist, **409** if it is incomplete or already claimed.

item.name: Badges
item.description: Full badge catalog with earned badges and progress for the current user.

request.description:
Returns all active badge definitions enriched with:
- `earned` — array of times the user has earned this badge (may be empty)
- `progress` — aggregate badge progress, or `null` if not started
- `requirements` — individual unlock requirements with current/required values, completion state, and completion timestamp

Equipment badges use `requirements` to show each part of an unlock. For example, Shield of Faith separately shows prayer days, completed Scripture plans, and acts of trust during difficulty.

item.name: Leaderboards
item.description: Ranked leaderboard entries scoped by time period and geography.

query.description: Time window: daily | weekly | monthly | yearly | season. Default: weekly.
Specific period code (e.g. 2026-W29). Omit to use the current active/finalized period.
Geographic scope: global | country | city. Default: global.
Scope identifier. Use "global" for global scope, a 2-letter ISO code for country (e.g. "US"), or a city UUID.

request.description:
Returns ranked leaderboard entries for the requested period and scope. Each entry is enriched with a `profile` (display name, username, avatar, title) and an `isCurrentUser` flag.

The response also includes `currentUserEntry`, which is the authenticated user's entry even when it falls outside the requested page (or `null` when no entry exists), plus the matched `period` object and pagination metadata (`total`, `limit`, `offset`).

**Example — country leaderboard for the US**
`?periodType=weekly&scopeType=country&scopeReference=US`

item.name: Prayer Map
item.description: Aggregated, privacy-filtered geographic markers showing where users are praying.

query.description: Start of the time window (ISO 8601). Required.
End of the time window (ISO 8601). Required.
Filter to a single country (2-letter ISO code, e.g. US). Optional.

request.description:
Returns aggregated prayer map markers. Markers with fewer than **5 unique users** are suppressed to protect privacy.

Each marker contains coordinates (country or city level), a `prayer_count`, and `unique_users`.

Response metadata includes the `level`, `from`, `to`, and the `privacyThreshold` (always 5).

item.name: Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications for the authenticated user.

query.description: Pass true to return only notifications where read_at is null.
Created-at cursor from `meta.nextCursor` for the next page.

request.description:
Returns the most recent notifications for the authenticated user, ordered newest-first, with cursor pagination metadata. Pass `unreadOnly=true` to see only unread items.

Battle notification types include `demon_defense_assigned`, `demon_defense_completed`, `demon_defeated`, `demon_encounter_abandoned`, and `equipment_unlocked`. Use each notification's `action_url` and structured `payload` to navigate to the relevant encounter, defense, or badge.

Sets `read_at` to the current timestamp for the given notification. The notification must belong to the authenticated user.

Set the `notificationId` collection variable to the UUID of the notification.

Returns **204 No Content** on success, **404** if the notification is not found.
